counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span explicitly identifies pembrolizumab or ipilimumab as the causative drug
No raw span documents improvement after drug withdrawal or rechallenge
No raw span reports peripheral eosinophilia or systemic involvement
decisive_items: superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
started as an erythematous papule on her right arm 2 months after initiation of a new immunotherapy regimen
response.rationale: R3 best combines the biopsy-proven eosinophilic dermatitis with the immunotherapy-related temporal onset; R5 captures the eosinophilic histology but omits drug causality, while R1 captures causality but lacks the eosinophilic subtype. R2/R6 arbitrarily attribute to one agent, and R4 is only descriptive morphology.

rejected.why: Broad irAE label; lacks the eosinophilic histologic subtype and is less specific than R3.
Arbitrary single-agent attribution to ipilimumab; raw spans only mention a new immunotherapy regimen and no eosinophilic histology.
Descriptive annular erythema only; ignores biopsy eosinophilic inflammation and drug timing.
Arbitrary single-agent attribution to pembrolizumab; same limitations as R2.
